name: CompTIA SecurityX

fee.note: US list price for one SecurityX voucher on CompTIA's store. Vouchers are country and currency specific, so the price differs by country. The same page lists a voucher with Retake Assurance at $709 and CertMaster bundles with a voucher from $748.

exam.format: Up to 90 multiple-choice and performance-based questions in up to 165 minutes, scored pass/fail with no scaled score. English and Japanese. CompTIA recommends at least ten years of hands-on IT experience, five of them in security, with Network+, Security+, CySA+, Cloud+ and PenTest+ or equivalent knowledge; it is a recommendation, not a prerequisite.

scope: Advanced security architecture and engineering for the enterprise: governance, risk, compliance and threat modeling, resilient and Zero Trust architecture, cloud security, IAM, endpoint and network security, automation and advanced cryptography, and security operations.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: SecurityX is the former CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+); the rename came with exam CAS-005 (V5), launched on December 17, 2024. CompTIA estimates CAS-005 will retire about three years after launch (2027); no successor had been announced on 2026-11-17.
Renewal: the certification lasts three years. Renew with 75 CEUs plus a $150 CE fee per three-year cycle, or by passing the latest version of the exam.

access.retake: No wait between the first and second attempt; at least 14 days before the third and later ones. Every attempt is paid in full, unless you bought a voucher with Retake Assurance, which includes one retake.
access.accommodations: In a non-English-speaking country, taking the exam in English when there is no localized version gives 30 extra minutes (ESL), added automatically at Pearson VUE.
